capabilities: track vault activity via file size and word count changes
display a GitHub-style heatmap of activity
switch between activity metrics and time periods
open the heatmap from the ribbon or command palette
extras: README explicitly compares the visualization to GitHub's contribution chart; activity is inferred from proxies (file size, word count) rather than direct edit events.
problem: Obsidian gives no overview of how active you have been in the vault over days, months, or years.

relations.evidence: provides a GitHub-style activity heatmap visualization of your note-taking activity

summary: GitHub-style activity heatmap that visualizes vault note-taking activity over time from file size and word count changes.
